name: shotcraft
description: A production crew for AI video and images: intake grilling, research, concept, two-column script, shot list, bible, layered prompt cards, cheap-first boards and drafts, approved finals, motion graphics, sound, assembly, delivery checks and a Higgsfield hand-off (assets uploaded plus a Canvas build sheet). Stage gates with evidence, a credit budget, reference rights, a QA loop and a learning loop. A local storyboard app for references and @ mentions. Also a fast 'just a prompt' mode. Higgsfield CLI by default; other providers plug in.
